description: Exact rational SOS factors and trigonometric multipliers. Discovery was floating point; validation uses exact Q(sqrt(3),i) arithmetic and explicit rational error bounds.
normalization: For each observation a, f_a(z)=|<a,w>|^2-1 with a a normalized reference column. h_a(z)=(constant+sum(cos*cos(angle)+sin*sin(angle)))/scale. sigma=sum|sum (factor_real+i*factor_imag) z^exponent /scale|^2. P=sum h_a*f_a-sigma.
claimed_scope: Not a global emptiness certificate. A fixed universal coefficient-dominance restriction and explicit forbidden neighborhood for actual 4+1, with variable carrier and outer quartet.
